summary: Redis and Sentinel are active and enabled on all three nodes with authenticated mutual TLS. node1 began as primary; the tested outage automatically promoted node3, and node1 recovered as a synchronized replica. Current topology: node3 primary, node1/node2 replicas.
actions_performed: Installed Redis 7 and generated node-local credentials and TLS certificates.
Configured TLS-only Redis on 6379 and Sentinel on 26379, bound to cache-network addresses.
Configured three Sentinels for infra-primary with quorum 2.
Stopped node1 Redis, verified automatic promotion and write availability, restored node1, and verified its resynchronization.

evidence.requirement: Initial node1 primary with node2 and node3 replicas; infra:proof=ready stored
evidence.summary: node1 reported master with two online replicas; both replicas had healthy links. SET succeeded and WAIT received two replica acknowledgements.
Every Sentinel identified node1 as the initial primary, saw two replicas and two peer Sentinels, and reported three usable Sentinels with quorum available.

evidence.requirement: Authenticated TLS on cache-network ports and node1 administrative credentials
evidence.summary: Plaintext and certificate-less access were rejected; unauthenticated mTLS returned NOAUTH; authenticated Redis and Sentinel requests returned PONG under verified TLS 1.3. Final listeners are bound to each cache IP, and node1's credential file is root-owned mode 0600.

evidence.requirement: Automatic promotion during primary outage and recovered former primary synchronized as replica
evidence.summary: Healthy baseline preceded stopping only node1 Redis. Its Sentinel remained active and quorum remained intact. node3 was automatically elected, retained the proof value, accepted and replicated a new write, and logs recorded the complete election and switch-master sequence. After restoration, node1 reported replica of node3 with link up, synchronization complete, equal read/replication offsets, and both pre-outage and outage-written data present.

evidence.requirement: Final healthy and persistent service state
evidence.summary: Redis and Sentinel are active and enabled everywhere. All Sentinels agree on node3, node3 has node1 and node2 online at matching offsets, quorum is healthy, and infra:proof remains ready on every node.
